Sequoia Arc — visible page text
sources.quote: Our bi-annual open call for outlier early stage founders. For 50+ years, we've backed founders at the earliest stages—Apple pre-revenue, Nvidia with just the founding team, Wiz when there wasn’t a clear idea. We find Sequoia founders in many ways, including Arc, our bi-annual open call for pre-seed and seed stage founders. From accelerating your path to PMF, to guidance and connections necessary to build with speed. Harness the power of our community and brand to access talent, customers, and more. We help you build for the next decade, not just the next quarter.
